title.zh: XRP Ledger修复存在近11年重大漏洞，攻击者曾可利用其凭空生成XRP
title.en: XRP Ledger修复存在近11年重大漏洞，攻击者曾可利用其凭空生成XRP

current_state.zh: XRP Ledger developers disclosed a critical payment-path vulnerability dating to 2015 that could have let attackers mint and spend XRP beyond the 100 billion supply cap, which they reproduced and fixed in xrpld 3.4.1 with no evidence of exploitation in the wild.
current_state.en: XRP Ledger developers disclosed a critical payment-path vulnerability dating to 2015 that could have let attackers mint and spend XRP beyond the 100 billion supply cap, which they reproduced and fixed in xrpld 3.4.1 with no evidence of exploitation in the wild.
